meta.description: Registry of mainstream Sunni tafsir editions. All editions below are FETCHABLE today from spa5k/tafsir_api (MIT, jsDelivr) — verified 2026-08-28 by Sheikh Al-Jabr. The platform presents; it does not adjudicate between schools. Per-surah endpoint shape: list of {text, ayah, surah}. ETL merges into ayah.tafsir[] keyed by source_id.
meta.source_authority: spa5k/tafsir_api — github.com/spa5k/tafsir_api (MIT). Earlier registry (v1.0) wrongly marked 9 editions 'available:false' citing quran.com's region-gated API; that API returns empty/404 from this environment. spa5k is our already-trusted source (it fed the embedded Jalalayn + Ibn Kathir in surah-1.json) and serves all editions as raw JSON.
meta.license_note: Repo distribution: MIT. Underlying tafsir texts: classical (public domain) or published editions reproduced by spa5k. The platform attributes each to its author and does not modify content.
